Claim 1 (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time interval, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from and more prominent than the first alarm.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to manage escalation of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an escalation status; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system is configured to communicate with a remote physiological monitor or central management system.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system and is capable of receiving alarm signals from remote monitoring devices.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm and tracks transitions between escalation levels.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm and a time at which acknowledgement occurred.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices only after a predetermined escalation threshold has been reached.
